author: KEXP
description: Seattle duo MYXA combine atmospheric synths and haunting melodies to create moody trip hop soundscapes. Live on KEXP with host DJ Morgan, the band deliver a performance of "Carrion" and more.
title: MYXA performs "Carrion" & more Live on KEXP
